qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Global oligopoly in elevators and escalators with over 1.5 million units in maintenance portfolio. High switching costs and regulatory safety mandates drive recurring maintenance and modernization (>60% of revenue). Unrivaled capital efficiency evidenced by >40% GAAP ROIC and near-100% tangible ROIC.
qualitative.note: Passes all 6 gates. Global elevator and escalator oligopolist with over 1.5 million units in its maintenance portfolio. Negative working capital, >CHF 2.2B net cash, 41%+ GAAP ROIC, and 130% FCF conversion insulate the business from construction cyclicality. [5-10Y g: maintenance portfolio units 4.0% + service price escalation 2.0% + modernization 1.5% - new installation slowdown 0.5%]
qualitative.evidence: FY2025 revenue of CHF 10.95B and EBIT of CHF 1.40B (12.8% operating margin). 4-year median GAAP ROIC is 41.5% (tangible operating ROIC ~98%). Owner FCF conversion is 130.7% (FY2025 FCF CHF 1.35B vs NI CHF 1.02B). Balance sheet holds CHF 2.30B in cash against CHF 110M in debt (CHF 2.2B net cash), with interest coverage over 32x. High-margin recurring maintenance and modernizations buffer the business against China new installation headwinds.
